artists.biography: Justin Townes Earle (born January 4, 1982) is an American singer-songwriter and musician. Earle records with Bloodshot Records and has five released albums from 2007–2012. He is the son of alternative country artist, Steve Earle.  Earle grew up in South Nashville, Tennessee, with his mother, Carol Ann Hunter Earle. His father Steve Earle gave Justin his middle name in honor of his mentor Townes van Zandt, but left Justin's mother when he was 2.

perplexity.description:
The Saint of Lost Causes is the eighth and final studio album by American singer-songwriter Justin Townes Earle, released on May 24, 2019, by New West Records. Rooted in folk, country, and Americana traditions, the album showcases Earle’s signature blend of acoustic guitar-driven melodies, raw vocals, and incisive storytelling. Musically, it leans into a more outward-looking perspective compared to his earlier, more personal works, with songs that traverse American landscapes and social issues, from the economic struggles of Flint, Michigan, to the plight of marginalized communities. The production, co-led by longtime collaborator Adam Bednarik, features a tight ensemble of Nashville musicians, lending the album a warm, organic sound that underscores its emotional depth.

Within Earle’s discography, The Saint of Lost Causes stands as a culmination of his artistic growth, marking a shift toward broader social commentary while retaining the introspective honesty that defined his previous albums. Critics praised the record for its unflinching truth-telling and empathetic songwriting, noting its thematic resonance with classic American folk and country traditions. The album was widely regarded as one of Earle’s strongest works, earning acclaim for its poignant narratives and musical craftsmanship, and solidifying his reputation as a vital voice in contemporary roots music.
